text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Thanks to the school we have
everything we need! Since
it's everyone's
first time playing karuta, let's go over the
rules.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Our variant involves two teams of four, but
just like in regular karuta,
you listen for
the first half of a poem, then take the card
with the
second half on it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So the only differences are the size of the
cards... and that you have
to run to get
them?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We run, and sometimes
clash... It's called the martial art
of the
humanities for good reason!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Each team splits into "finders" and "takers."
Basically, people who
look for the
matching card, and those who go and get
it.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Well, who better to give commands
than yours truly? I, T.M.
Opera O, shall
don the mantle of finder. Are you ready,
Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! Th-that means I'm a taker. I-I'll do
my best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right then, Urara, that leaves us to pair
up. Think you're up to be a
finder?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okie dokie! I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure there are more rules, but
I'm no expert either. So why
don't we learn
by doing and give it a go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
First things first, our reciter will be this
nifty app... The conveniences
of modern
life, am I right? Okay then...

text_block_list.name: Reciter App
text_block_list.text:
Springtime is now upon us, the blossoming
plum declares...
Umamusume, go forth
unto the finish—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now off with you Doto, upon wings of
gold! To the south, secondo da
destra!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wha? S-south? You mean this way? Or this
way?! Oooh, wh-which
way is it?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so what am I supposed to be
finding?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urara! It's "Negishi's trodden turf heights"!
Look for the one that starts
with "ne"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ne... ne... Found it! Fuku, over there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Where's there?! I've never heard more
ambiguous directions!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, which way's south?! I th-th-think
that side gets sunlight in the
morning,
which means...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh no no, not Meisho "Doh"-to! Run
straight or you'll crash into
someone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? There's two "ne" cards. Hey, Fuku,
which one do we want?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bwoohh?! Urara, the one that goes "ne"
then "gi"!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait, "gi"? Then this is the wrong one...
wh-whoa! M-my foot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hyikes! Doto, this isn't the time to be
practicing twirls! Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Doto & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Owww!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was such a disaster I almost feel
refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Nnghh... Sorry, if only I wasn't so clumsy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense, Doto, it's not your fault! We're
all beginners here, after all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But... if I didn't trip, I wouldn't have
brought you down with me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No worries, no worries. It's not like you did
it on purpose, we all know
that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Plus, did you forget already? Shiraoki
foretold that if we join forces in
a
competition, great, great fortune awaits!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Which means, if we all enter the karuta
tournament together, then win
or lose,
good fortune will be ours!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but... can we really say we "joined
forces" if all we do is show up?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course we can! Imagine the great
Shiraoki telling amateurs like us
"You
better win!" She would never.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As long as we all take part and have fun,
everyone goes home happy!
That's what
she wanted to get across, if you ask me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Th-that kind of makes sense...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, I shouldn't be tripping left and right.
Wouldn't want anyone
getting hurt... I
really need to practice...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, wipe that worry off your face.
Where smiles bloom, fortune
looms!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I may... At times, a little rehearsal
is in order! So as your
commander, allow
me to ask you this...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When you think "commander," does this
strike you as a fitting pose?
Or perhaps
this?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so cool! I wanna try too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooh, looking good! But why not take it a step further, like this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(They're all so... motivated. Ohh, I need to
practice so I don't screw
up...)
